title: Chapter 787
text:
The dynasty's elite soldiers did things swiftly and decisively. The four of them briefly introduced themselves, did not request to rest, and immediately applied to undergo the modification.

Hearing this, Han Xiao did not reject. He would have plenty of time to communicate after the modification was completed.

Buzz …

With a flash of blue-gold Mechanical Force, the small silver cube hovered above his head. He entered the password to activate it, and the evolution energy spread out like a tide in the hall, enveloping tens of thousands of elites wearing the dynasty's standard military uniform.

Putting away the Evolution Cube, Han Xiao looked at the black cocoons in the hall and nodded.

Looking at Teny's black cocoon, Han Xiao curled his lips and thought to himself, Since you've delivered yourself to me, how can I not invest in you …

He was quite familiar with the life history of this future dynasty commander. He was one of the famous NPCs of the dynasty in many versions.

Later on, he led many large fleets of the dynasty independently and was known as the 'Dynasty's Iron Heel'. He had fought many legendary battles and had outstanding performances in many versions. The dynasty's players could choose to join him and become his soldiers or officers. There were plenty of war missions.

Teny was most famous for two things. The first was in the [Calamity of the Supers] version, where he led his fleet to surround and kill a Beyond Grade A who was causing trouble without the help of any experts!

The second was in the invasion of the World Tree Civilization. In order to control the overall situation, he led his fleet to charge into hundreds of Star Systems and stopped the enemy from invading. He fought his way into the World Tree Civilization's hinterland like a hot knife through butter, buying a lot of time. In the end, his fleet was completely wiped out by the enemy, and he died on the battlefield with countless strong enemies.

Teny's strength was only at the Calamity Grade, but he was a very powerful commander, strategist, and fleet commander. He was good at cooperating with large armies, and the dynasty's fleet could display shocking strength in his hands. To the dynasty, such a powerful military talent was even more important than a Beyond Grade A with individual strength.

According to the trajectory of his life, Teny Amenos would hold a high position in the dynasty in the future. Now that he had the opportunity to make friends with the dynasty's future military boss, Han Xiao naturally would not let it go.

There were many factions within the dynasty. The first batch of dynasty elites to be modified were the elites chosen from the various factions. Most of the spots had been split up. The military youth faction that Teny represented was a very powerful faction. He would become one of the representatives of the faction in the future, so it was worth making friends with him.

Han Xiaoxin knew that even though he had become an ally of the Red Empire, this was only the beginning, and he could not rest easy. Even as an ally, he had to think of ways to increase his influence within the dynasty. After all … he was not the only Beyond Grade A in the dynasty.

I've been operating in the Shattered Star Ring for more than twenty years and can be considered a big shot. However, in the Central Galaxy, there are more Beyond Grade As than in the Shattered Star Ring, and many of them are veterans who have been around for many years. My influence there is very limited, Han Xiao thought.

A Universal Civilization had a huge population, countless strong people, and many allies. The interest network was very complicated. Although he had a high position in the dynasty, his right to speak was pitifully small. This was already taking into account the additional value of the Evolution Cube.

The other three captains beside Teny were also well-known figures. They did not have as many achievements as Teny, but since they were leeks that were sent to his door, he decided to take them all in one go.

"Speaking of which …"

Han Xiao suddenly had an idea.

"I have the Evolution Cube, and the Red Empire will keep sending people over. Is this considered waiting … er, waiting for leeks?"

…

The evolution lasted for half a day, and tens of thousands of dynasty elites broke out of their cocoons one after another.

Teny was the last to complete his evolution. He stretched out his hand and clenched his fist in front of him, familiarizing himself with the changes in his body.

"This feels great …" Corbus was overjoyed. He originally did not have the qualifications to be chosen, but because he was Teny's adjutant, he was given this opportunity.

"It's indeed very magical. It feels even better than the genetic adjustment of the Radiant Federation." Teny nodded.

The newborns of a Universal Civilization would usually go through free genetic adjustment when they were born to increase their potential.

The genetic adjustment technology of the Radiant Federation was far superior to the other two civilizations. This was one of their specialties. The ratio of Supers in the Radiant Federation was the highest in the entire Galaxy.

The army affairs officer, who had been waiting by the side, greeted them and said, "Friends from the Red Empire, the Army Commander ordered me to wait here for you to complete your evolution before bringing you to the army's guest area to rest."

Everyone nodded. Some of them were going to follow the dynasty's logistics team to explore the Flickering World. The fleet was expected to rest in the Black Star Corps headquarters for a while, so they naturally had to wait.

The other group of dynasty elites was only there to undergo evolution and would return to the Central Galaxy after it was done. Teny was one of them, and Han Xiao happened to be planning to go with them. Zoel had already told them, so they had to stay in the army's headquarters and wait for Han Xiao to depart together.

They arrived at the guest area and stayed there. Not long after, Han Xiao arrived. Teny and a few other team leaders went out to welcome him.

As soon as Han Xiao entered, he first asked them how they felt about their evolution. He then changed the topic to the dynasty's internal affairs and started chatting.

The elites from the Red Empire were indeed different. Perhaps because they had seen many Beyond Grade As as officers of a Universal Civilization, their attitude was very natural. They were not nervous or arrogant, sitting together and chatting.

He was here to build a relationship with these future dynasty military bigwigs and increase their understanding of each other so that they could become good friends in the future.

He had a deep understanding of the people present, so they chatted happily.

However, Han Xiao noticed that only Teny was the calmest. He had been observing him and seemed to be on guard.

This was their first interaction, so Han Xiao did not talk too much. He stood up and left after familiarizing himself with each other. Making friends without benefits had to be done step by step. Attacking as soon as they met would easily backfire.

After sending Black Star off, Teny looked at his back and pondered.

'What is this guy trying to do …?'

…

"Teny seems to be on guard against me. He doesn't seem to be easy to get along with …"

Returning to the Army Commander's office, Han Xiao tapped the table rhythmically with his fingers.

It was indeed not easy to make friends with high-level talents. He had to cater to their interests.

Han Xiao nodded. This was his advantage. He knew Teny's hobbies like the back of his hand. This was all hidden information that the players in his previous life had unearthed after countless trials and errors. He wondered just how many strange gifts Teny had received over the years.

"He doesn't have high requirements for material objects. He only likes certain types of gifts … Hmm, he seems to have a habit of collecting Star Core samples? If I remember correctly, he also likes to read mechanical theory books written by high-level Mechanics … Sigh, even outstanding people have such high-end hobbies. "

Han Xiao shook his head. With such an unpopular hobby, even if he wanted to give a gift, he had to use a more tactful method. Otherwise, it would be easy to expose his purpose. If others knew that he had investigated him, it might have the opposite effect.

"However, mechanical theory books …" Han Xiaoxin thought. "I'm a Beyond Grade A Mechanic. He might take the initiative to bring it up."

Putting this matter aside for the time being, Han Xiao called Nero, who was being brought around the headquarters by Hella and Reynold.

Not long after, Reynold pushed the door open and entered.

"Army Commander, you're looking for me?"

"I have a mission for you."

As he spoke, Han Xiao turned to look at Nero, who was curious about aliens. He smiled and said, "Nero, you will learn mechanical theory from Reynold during this period of time. I have to go out and do something. I'll teach you personally after I'm done."

Nero was a little anxious and said with grievance, "You promised to bring me around the universe …"

The universe was a completely foreign environment to him, and the only person he could rely on was Han Xiao. Hearing that he would be left alone in the headquarters, Nero panicked.

This reminded him of his father, Bennett. He had promised to bring him out to play time and time again, but he would always use work as an excuse, leaving him disappointed time and time again. In his young world, adults would always go back on their words, and he was afraid that Han Xiao would do the same.

"Don't worry, when I return, I'll definitely bring you to some fun places …" Han Xiao comforted him.

The Central Galaxy was filled with experts, and he did not know what he would encounter. Nero was too fragile, and he would be in danger if he followed him. Thus, it was better for him to stay in the headquarters. With so many officers and allies looking after him, it would be much safer than following him.

Furthermore, Nero had just awakened his Mechanical Force and needed to learn a lot of theoretical knowledge. Since he had to do his homework, it did not matter where he did it!

He had considered leaving Nero under Reynold's tutelage for the time being. While Nero was learning the basics from Reynold, the Advanced Luck Glow might be able to steal this guy's Perfect Mechanical Sense. After all, Nero was a high-level protagonist type character, and anything was possible. It was too normal for him to awaken a talent.

"No problem, leave it to me." Reynold nodded.

Han Xiao paused for a moment and suddenly thought of something. "By the way, is your sister still in the army?"

"Hmm?" Reynold was stunned. "She's still here. What's wrong?"

It seemed like Rossellin had not run away with those three kids yet … Han Xiao stroked his chin. Only he and Rossellin knew about this. Even Reynold did not tell him.

"Then, what has she been doing recently? Has she done anything strange? "

"Strange … I think so." Reynold thought for a moment and said with a serious expression, "I realized that she hasn't been going out much recently and has been cooped up in her room. I don't know what she's doing, and she usually doesn't come to chat with me. I've asked her a few times, and she said that she's writing something, but I don't know what it is. Do you need me to help you ask?"

"There's no need." Han Xiao waved his hand. He could roughly guess what Rossellin was doing. She was probably writing the program of the Silver Revolutionary Army.

Although the goal of this group of founders was only to overthrow the three Universal Civilizations and give the other civilizations a chance to make a comeback, helping one ruling class overthrow another ruling class, they naturally could not use this method to incite ordinary people. Rossellin was the spiritual leader, and many of the slogans and ideas were written by her. She also injected her Esper Ability into these ideas.

He had no intention of interfering with the birth of the Silver Revolutionary Army because this was the choice of the era. He alone could not stop the wheel of the entire era. In summary, this plot could be considered the first time in the countless years of peace in the exploration era that various advanced civilizations had teamed up to challenge the ruling position of the three Universal Civilizations … No civilization was willing to be ruled forever. When ambition and strength reached a certain limit, the new strong would inevitably clash with the old hegemony. It was simply unavoidable.

Therefore, it would be better to sit back and watch the situation unfold. At least, they would have the upper hand and be easier to deal with than strangers.

Han Xiao then carried the aggrieved Nero and placed him on his lap. He then called Sylvia and Herlous over and asked, "I'll be heading to the Central Galaxy in a few days.

"I will go to the Central Galaxy in a few days. Have you prepared the manpower, warships, and resources that I asked you to send?"

The three of them nodded.

"Very good." Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief.

This trip to the Central Galaxy was not for a vacation; he had many things to do.

Speaking of which, this was the first time in his life that he was leaving the Shattered Star Ring and heading to another Star Field.
